output_fmt.title: Output Format
output_fmt.description: Format of the published recalibrated alignment. CRAM is smaller.

cram_version.title: CRAM Version
cram_version.description: 3.0 is readable by essentially all tools; 3.1 is smaller but some tools (and coverage QC, which is skipped) cannot read it.

quantization.title: Quality-Score Quantization Options

quantize_quals_enabled.title: Quantize Quality Scores
quantize_quals_enabled.description: Replicate GATK ApplyBQSR static quantization. Turn off to publish the unquantized recalibrated file.

preserve_qscores_less_than.title: Preserve Quality Scores Below
preserve_qscores_less_than.description: Quality scores below this value remain unchanged (GATK --preserve-qscores-less-than). Must be below the smallest bin.

round_down_quantized.title: Round Down
round_down_quantized.description: Round down to the largest bin at or below each score, instead of the nearest bin in probability space.

quantization.description: Collapses base qualities into a few bins to shrink the output; see the README lookup table for how scores map.
